doc: frame key = piece/variant/part/state/rot ; frames[key] = [x, y, w, h, anchorX, anchorY] in kit_atlas.png (anchor = pixel of the piece origin); key#shadow = ground shadow frame; emit[] = keys with pixels in kit_emit.png; masks[key] = [cols, rows, base64 packbits] opaque 4px cells for occluder fade tests. Units: metres, x east, y north, z up.
